about_text: I build tools, bots and small products that scratch my own itch — then ship them so others can use them too. From game automation to web apps, I like turning repetitive problems into clean, working software.
proj_sub: A few projects I'm proud of — web apps and tools made to be actually useful.
proj_carto: A strategic online collectible card game — collect dragons, build decks and battle friends in classic and attribute duels. Server-authoritative and trilingual (EN/PT/ES).
proj_coin: A personal investing platform: automate Binance crypto trades (DCA, take-profit, price alerts) and track your B3 stock portfolio and dividends — all in one dashboard.
games_sub: Automation and tooling for the games I actually play.
game_desc: An autoplay bot for Hero Wars: Dominion Era. It automates the repetitive grind — climbing the Tower and conquering the Titan's Dungeon — so you can focus on the fun parts of the game.
game_how: Download it, read the README, follow the steps and run the executable. Windows only.
